title: The Nine instruct building a copper Faraday cage for clearer transmission
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of The Nine instruct building a copper Faraday cage for clearer transmission, about 1950s at Round Table Foundation, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
